title: Mission control split between NASA and the Air Force

tellings.quote: at the consoles. And you look to the left, it's exactly the same, but it's all Air Force people.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and that NASA, the US space agency, has studied him, describes visiting mission control at Cape Canaveral, Florida, with a contact named Timothy Taylor. He says that on one side sat people at the consoles, and on the left was an identical setup staffed entirely by Air Force people. To him it suggests the military runs a hidden twin of the civilian space operation.
